metadata.coordinates: LOCAL X east, Y north in metres, relative to origin; not longitude/latitude; no z supplied
metadata.selection: Complete mapped geometries within 150m of the circuit; POI landmarks allowed farther. Large selected landuse polygons can extend farther than 150m. Road ways include circuit-source ways explicitly flagged; partially used circuit-source ways still flagged as a whole.
metadata.geometry: Full mapped polygon exteriors and interior rings retained; no clipping or fictional outlines; coordinates rounded to 0.01m
metadata.height_warning: All building heights lacking a numeric height tag are merely suggested block heights. OSM level counts do not specify surveyed storey heights; roofs/facades/colours/current condition unverified. Even tagged OSM heights are not independently surveyed here.
metadata.imagery_warning: Source is mapped OSM geometry, no aerial textures. Coverage is not proof every real building is mapped.

height_info.assumption: floor spacing assumed 3m + 1.2m roof allowance; level count from OSM
